items.title: File Widerspruch against denial of orthopedic insoles coverage
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 14.04.2025, sent by a statutory health insurer (Krankenkasse), a social-law body governed by § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X. No separate posting date is stated, so the printed date counts as the posting day. Delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (letter posted after 1 Jan 2025): 14.04.2025 + 4 days = 18.04.2025 (Friday). This falls on Good Friday (Karfreitag), a nationwide holiday, but for social-law bodies (unlike tax offices) the delivery day does NOT shift for weekends/holidays. So delivery = 18.04.2025. The one-month Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG starts the next day; the day of delivery is not counted (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X with § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). One month later, same day number: 18.05.2025 (Sunday). Since the end of the period falls on a Sunday, it moves to the next working day (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X, § 193 BGB): Monday 19.05.2025. No holiday falls on that Monday in NW.
